426:t_011:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's $$サイデリアル$$'s fourth Reactor...!」

426:t_011:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「The only zodiac signs we haven't seen yet are Sagittarius and Pisces...!」

426:t_011:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If $$アサキム$$ has one of them, then the last one really is with $$サイデリアル$$...!」

426:t_013:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I brought your beloved Miss $$スズネ$$, just as I promised.」

426:t_013:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バルビエル$$! What have you done to Miss $$スズネ$$!?」

426:t_013:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I haven't done anything. That's her true self.」

426:t_013:4.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$! Why are you piloting $$ジェミニア#robot$$!?」

426:t_013:5.en:
???
「This...? The machine that good-for-nothing piloted was repaired. It's not a bad ride.」

426:t_013:8.en:
???
「That's right, $n. You're going to give me back the $$いがみ合う双子$$' $$スフィア$$.」

426:t_013:10.en:
???
「Or will you get out of $$ジェニオン$$? That would be more convenient for me too.」

426:t_013:12.en:
???
「You don't have to say it. I know your answer is no. We've known each other a long time.」

426:t_013:13.en:
???
「But you see, $$ジェニオン$$ was originally meant for me to pilot.」

426:t_013:15.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're saying Miss $$スズネ$$ is $$ジェニオン$$'s real pilot...!?」

426:t_013:18.en:
???
「There's no point asking that blockhead, so I'll tell you. Like a proper teacher.」

426:t_013:19.en:
???
「$$ジェニオン$$ was built to resemble $$ジェミニア#robot$$ and steal its $$スフィア$$... A shoddy imitation, as $$ガドライト#pilot$$ called it.」

426:t_013:20.en:
???
「But with me as its pilot, $$ジェニオン$$ was supposed to steal $$ジェミニア#robot$$'s $$スフィア$$ and become a perfect $$ＤＥＭ$$.」

426:t_013:22.en:
???
「Accept it, $n. That's the truth about $$ジェニオン$$.」

426:t_013:23.en:
$n
「Stop, Miss $$スズネ$$! What are you saying?!」

426:t_013:24.en:
???
「I am $$西条涼音$$, and yet I am not $$西条涼音$$.」

426:t_013:25.en:
???
「Naturally, I'm not under any form of mind control. Disappointing for you, I'm sure.」

426:t_013:27.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's unpleasant having you keep calling me that. My name is... yes, $$アムブリエル$$.」

426:t_013:28.en:
$$万丈$$
「That's the name of the zodiac's angel of Gemini.」

426:t_014:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're a foolish boy.」

426:t_015:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「There's no point calling him. Soon he won't feel pain or sorrow anymore.」

426:t_015:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「It's the $$スフィアの反作用$$!」

426:t_015:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The hope of facing the woman he loves, and the despair of having that woman take his life... That will break $n's mind.」

426:t_015:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It really does seem he was born under a star that dooms him to betrayal by those he loves.」

426:t_016:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now, $$アムブリエル$$. As the rightful owner of the $$いがみ合う双子$$, drag him out of the cockpit.」

426:t_016:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Don't give me orders, $$バルビエル$$.」

426:t_018:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「This is a good opportunity. $$クロウ・ブルースト$$ of the $$揺れる天秤$$... I'll erase you.」

426:t_018:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You mean I'm in your way, like $$セツコ$$ is for $$バルビエル$$?」

426:t_018:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「This has nothing to do with the $$スフィア$$s.」

426:t_018:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's the first time you've shown emotion, $$尸空#pilot$$!」

426:t_019:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「That machine... It's $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

426:t_019:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「It looks like he's here to save $n from danger.」

426:t_019:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's right. Leave him to me.」

426:t_019:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This isn't even a crisis! Not for $n, and not for me!」

426:t_020:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$... I really don't like having someone babysit me.」

426:t_020:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'll move forward with my own strength!」

426:t_020:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「$$クロウ・ブルースト$$...! That strong will of yours disrupts my very existence...!」

426:t_021:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「It looks like you've broken through the wall too.」

426:t_021:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's how it is, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. The same goes for $n.」
